system.description:
Deal [(SR+1)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target. The target can not move to the same Sq as any other ally (this effect is handled as Bad Status). If you are already at the same Sq, you can not move to the same Sq again after leaving once. However, this effect is invalid for forced movement.

A throwing technique that anticipates the enemy's movement path and attacks to block it, preventing them from approaching allies.
